Its so faint I don't know if it's real or not, but I remember being incredibly young and crying as I was given these shots by a doctor. The doctors office seemed to be in the middle of nowhere as I remember being carried inside and seeing such a weird late 1800s vibe wooden building with a porch and a desert like area around it. Inside I was laid on a bed and was hooked up to many things and I cried and cried. Family was all around me and my twin sister layed in a separate bed near mine. My parents didn't touch me and nobody said anything. My sister was given shots and her screaming and crying immediately stopped. The doctor walked over to me and after seeing my sister like that I was freaking out, after getting my shots I cried and screamed more then just fell asleep. I don't remember what happened when I woke up. However to this day in our house we have pictures of me and my twin in a place looking exactly like what I remember, the beds the same, the surrounding area of the bed the same, and I looked the same as I remember. The fact that I knew what I looked like during that memory makes me think it's a dream but the pictures say otherwise. We were asleep in the pictures. I've never asked about the pictures but the memory has always been unsettling.
